data.notes: October 2026 in Las Vegas is heavily shaped by Halloween club programming, arena-scale hip-hop/pop concerts, and one-of-a-kind Sphere residency dates.

events.title: Metallica: Life Burns Faster at Sphere
events.summary: Metallica’s Life Burns Faster Sphere residency includes an explicitly listed October 31, 2026 Las Vegas date as part of its No Repeat Weekend format.

events.title: Doja Cat: Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat brings the Tour Ma Vie World Tour to T-Mobile Arena on Saturday, October 31, 2026, with Latto listed on the bill.

events.title: Megan Thee Stallion's Hottieween
events.summary: Megan Thee Stallion’s Hottieween takes over Zouk Nightclub on Friday, October 30, 2026, with a portion of proceeds noted for the Pete & Thomas Foundation.

events.title: Martin Garrix w/ Justin Mylo - Halloween Weekend
events.summary: Martin Garrix headlines OMNIA Nightclub’s Halloween Weekend event with Justin Mylo, running from October 31, 2026 at 10:30 PM to November 1 at 4:00 AM.

events.title: Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber
events.summary: Wu-Tang Clan’s Final Chamber Tour stops at T-Mobile Arena with Mobb Deep listed as special guest. This is the month’s biggest classic hip-hop arena play.

events.title: Dom Dolla at LIV Las Vegas
events.summary: Dom Dolla headlines LIV Las Vegas at Fontainebleau on Friday, October 9, 2026, with the venue billing it as a house-music night on the Strip.

events.title: Tiësto at LIV Las Vegas
events.summary: Tiësto plays a confirmed resident-DJ date at LIV Las Vegas on Friday, October 16, 2026.

events.title: Adriatique - Halloween at LIV Las Vegas
events.summary: Adriatique headlines LIV Las Vegas on Halloween night, Saturday, October 31, 2026 at 10:30 PM, with the venue describing the duo’s sound as house and techno.

events.title: TAEMIN: 2026-27 TAEMIN WORLD TOUR <LiMiNaL>
events.summary: TAEMIN brings the 2026-27 <LiMiNaL> world tour to T-Mobile Arena on Friday, October 16, 2026 at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Strong Music Festival 2026
events.summary: Strong Music Festival 2026 is confirmed for Friday, October 30, 2026 at Thomas & Mack Center, with Yeat, Destroy Lonely, Waka Flocka Flame, slayr, Babyfxce E and others listed on the Live Nation lineup.

events.title: Chase & Status at Zouk Nightclub
events.summary: Chase & Status headline Zouk Nightclub on Saturday, October 31, 2026, with doors listed at 10:30 PM.

events.title: Tacos & Tequila Festival Las Vegas
events.summary: Touring 2000s hip-hop and R&B nostalgia festival making its Las Vegas stop with T.I., Fat Joe, Pretty Ricky, Trina, Chingy, Petey Pablo, Ying Yang Twins and more, plus tacos, tequila bars and lucha libre.

events.title: ScAREA15: Strange Circus presents Khan-O-Ween
events.summary: AREA15’s 18+ Halloween-night electronic takeover spreads across the district with Valentino Khan’s Khan-O-Ween concept and a Strange Circus immersive production footprint.

events.title: Don Toliver at Zouk Nightclub
events.summary: Don Toliver headlines Zouk Nightclub at Resorts World Las Vegas on Saturday, October 17, 2026.

events.title: Hugel with support by Juany Bravo
events.summary: Hugel plays Encore Beach Club At Night on Friday, October 23, 2026, with Juany Bravo listed as support.

events.title: Chief Keef
events.summary: Chief Keef has a second-show-added Brooklyn Bowl Las Vegas date on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, with doors listed at 7:30 PM.

events.title: Madeon presents Victory Live
events.summary: Madeon brings Victory Live to House of Blues Las Vegas with Contact Sports also listed on the lineup.

events.title: ScHoolboy Q - 10 Years of Blank Face LP
events.summary: Brooklyn Bowl Las Vegas lists ScHoolboy Q’s 10 Years of Blank Face LP show for Saturday, October 17, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM.

events.title: Metallica: Life Burns Faster
events.summary: Metallica opens its Life Burns Faster residency at Sphere with an explicitly listed October 1, 2026 performance. The Sphere run is billed around the band’s No Repeat Weekend format.

events.title: Earth, Wind & Fire at The Venetian Theatre
events.venueName: The Venetian Theatre at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
events.summary: Earth, Wind & Fire return to The Venetian Theatre for a nine-show limited engagement from October 16 through October 31, 2026. The announced dates include October 16, 17, 18, 21, 23, 24, 28, 30, and 31.

events.title: Scorpions – Coming Home to Las Vegas
events.venueName: PH Live at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino
events.summary: Scorpions return to PH Live for a Las Vegas residency running September 17 through October 3, 2026, with Buckcherry as special guest. Confirmed October performances are October 1 and October 3.

events.title: Lazy Peach Music Festival 2026
events.summary: Debut multi-genre destination festival promising 60+ artists across hip-hop, R&B, electronic, reggae, and global sounds, plus immersive art, VIP lounges, food, and nightlife-style activations.

events.title: Reggae Rise Up Las Vegas 2026
events.venueName: TBA - Downtown Las Vegas Event Center
events.summary: Touring reggae/roots festival brand’s Vegas weekend, with a lineup that also crosses into hip-hop via Public Enemy, E-40 & Too $hort, and Shwayze alongside reggae and island-rooted acts.

events.title: Kygo at Palm Tree Beach Club
events.summary: Large-scale Saturday dayclub session at MGM Grand’s Palm Tree Beach Club, a 3,000-capacity pool venue built around tropical-house and EDM headliners.

events.title: Juanes – North America Tour 2026
events.summary: Juanes brings his North America Tour 2026 to Pearl Concert Theater on October 10, 2026. The AXS event page lists an 8:00 p.m. show time.

events.title: Steve Aoki at OMNIA Nightclub
events.summary: Confirmed Saturday-night Strip megaclub booking for Steve Aoki, fitting the high-energy EDM/pop-electronic residency lane rather than an arena show.

events.title: Ludovico Einaudi: Solo Piano
events.venueName: Encore Theater at Wynn Las Vegas
events.summary: Composer and pianist Ludovico Einaudi performs a solo piano concert at Wynn Las Vegas’ Encore Theater on October 7, 2026. Wynn lists the show at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
events.summary: Lynyrd Skynyrd is confirmed for Pearl Concert Theater at Palms Casino Resort on October 3, 2026. The AXS listing gives an 8:00 p.m. show time.

events.title: Rise Against with Alkaline Trio
events.summary: Rise Against’s Ricochet 2026 tour stops at Pearl Concert Theater on October 17, 2026, with Alkaline Trio listed on the bill. AXS lists the concert at 7:00 p.m.

events.title: Mustard Halloween Night at Hakkasan
events.summary: Halloween-night hip-hop club booking with DJ Mustard at Hakkasan inside MGM Grand, positioned as a costume-friendly Vegas nightlife event rather than a concert hall show.

events.title: Taking Back Sunday with Thrice and Saves The Day
events.summary: Taking Back Sunday plays Pearl Concert Theater on October 18, 2026, with Thrice and Saves The Day also listed. The AXS page confirms a 7:00 p.m. show time.

events.title: R&B Fest - Las Vegas
events.summary: Touring R&B Fest party at downtown’s We All Scream, built around DJs playing 90s/00s R&B and hip-hop anthems with dancers, visuals, and singalong club energy.

events.title: Donny Osmond Residency
events.venueName: Harrah's Showroom at Harrah's Las Vegas
events.summary: Donny Osmond’s long-running Las Vegas residency has a confirmed October 9, 2026 performance at Harrah’s Showroom. The Ticketmaster listing gives a 7:30 p.m. show time.

events.title: Bed By 10pm - Las Vegas
events.summary: Touring early-evening 30+ clubbing party at We All Scream, focused on 80s, 90s, and early-2000s club classics with a DJ-led dancefloor format ending by 10pm.
